title: Chicken Stalker
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Taira, a staff member at a men-only SM club, is asked by the club's top performer to 'punish' a timid college student, Tatsuki, who has been stalking him. Tatsuki accepts the arrangement as a way to work on his cowardice and poor communication, and a romance develops. The boys' love collection adds linked stories about other club figures and unrelated shorts.
life_message: Facing your fears and learning to speak up can open the way to love, even from an awkward start.
